# Pac Armed Security

> Hawaiian family-based private security company founded in 2021 in Las Vegas by two local boys from Hawaii, providing licensed armed and unarmed security guard services across Oahu, Hawaii and Nevada.

Phone: (808) 435-5022
Service areas: Oahu / Hawaii; Nevada
Slogan: Professional Protection. Island Values.

## Services
- [Armed Security Guards](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/armed-security-guards/): Licensed armed officers for high-risk sites, valuables, and situations that call for a visible deterrent.
- [Unarmed Security Guards](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/unarmed-security-guards/): Professional unarmed officers for access control, patrols, and a steady, reassuring presence.
- [Mobile Patrol](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/mobile-patrol/): Marked-vehicle patrols and alarm response that cover more ground for less than a full-time post.
- [Event Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/event-security/): Coordinated coverage for concerts, private functions, corporate events, and large gatherings.
- [Construction Site Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/construction-site-security/): Overnight and weekend protection against theft, trespassing, and vandalism on active job sites.
- [Commercial Property Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/commercial-property-security/): Consistent coverage for office buildings, business parks, and mixed-use commercial spaces.
- [Apartment, Condo & HOA Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/apartment-condo-hoa-security/): Residential coverage that protects units, amenities, and residents without feeling intrusive.
- [Hotel & Resort Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/hotel-resort-security/): Guest-first protection for hotels and resorts that balances hospitality with real security.
- [Retail Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/retail-security/): Loss-prevention and uniformed officers that deter theft and keep shoppers comfortable.
- [Executive Protection](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/executive-protection/): Discreet close protection for executives, VIPs, and high-profile visitors.
- [Access Control Support](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/access-control-support/): Officers who manage entries, credentials, and visitor flow at your gates and lobbies.
- [Fire Watch Security](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/services/fire-watch-security/): Temporary fire watch coverage when alarm or sprinkler systems are offline.

## Industries served
- [Apartments, Condos & HOAs](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/apartments-condos-hoas/): Residential communities that need dependable, respectful protection for residents and amenities.
- [Hotels & Resorts](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/hotels-resorts/): Guest-first coverage that protects the property while preserving a welcoming atmosphere.
- [Retail Centers](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/retail-centers/): Stores and shopping centers that need visible deterrence and steady loss prevention.
- [Construction Sites](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/construction-sites/): Active job sites facing constant risk of equipment, material, and copper theft.
- [Commercial Buildings](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/commercial-buildings/): Offices, business parks, and mixed-use properties that expect a consistent presence.
- [Events & Venues](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/events-venues/): Concerts, functions, and corporate gatherings that need coordinated crowd management.
- [Parking Lots & Garages](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/parking-lots-garages/): Structures and lots where visibility, patrols, and quick response reduce incidents.
- [Warehouses & Industrial Sites](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/industries/warehouses-industrial/): Distribution, storage, and industrial facilities that need perimeter and access protection.

## Training
- [Pac Armed Training Academy](https://pacarmedsecurity.com/training/): security officer certification (armed &amp; unarmed), CCW, executive protection, active shooter response, defensive tactics, CPR/AED, and custom corporate training in Nevada and Hawaii.
